## Master Formulation Benchmark & Production Traceability
- **Master Formulation Benchmark Assay (Report #LAL-NN-121023002)**: Foundational independent NABL laboratory assay from Lilaba Analytical Laboratories (analyzed under NABL accreditation scope TC-7179) establishing baseline proximate chemistry (62.3% plant protein under IS 7219 and 291.15 mg/kg elemental iron) for Sujata's proprietary Arthrospira platensis strain and sub-40°C dehydration methodology.
- **Commercial Batch Traceability**: Commercial production batches (such as Batch #SJT-2026-B08) are contract-manufactured to this exact certified formulation by Spiru Swastha India Pvt Ltd under FSSAI Category 13 release standards.

## Proprietary Technology & Differentiators
1. **Sub-40°C Low-Thermal Dehydration**: Biomass is gently dehydrated under sub-40°C controlled airflow, protecting heat-sensitive phycobiliproteins, enzymes, and delicate polyunsaturated fatty acids from heat oxidation.
2. **Bio-Secure Hydro-Dome Cultivation**: Cultivated in isolated, alkaline deep-bore water systems (pH 9.2–10.5) shielded from airborne industrial pollution, bird droppings, and wild surface cyanobacteria.
3. **Clean-Label Zero Binders**: Free from synthetic excipients, talc, magnesium stearate, and artificial tableting binders. Fresh, clean natural earthy scent without rotten swamp or fishy odors.

### Assay Domain 02: Botanical Phytochemical Biomarkers & Bio-Enzymes (Sub-40°C Preserved Matrix)
- **Active C-Phycocyanin**: 21.4% Intact Active Matrix (214 mg/g, Bennett & Bogorad UV-Vis Spectrophotometric Protocol at λ = 620nm).
- **Superoxide Dismutase (SOD)**: >12,000 Units/kg (12 U/g, Marklund & Marklund Pyrogallol Autoxidation Kinetic Assay).
- **Total Chlorophyll-a**: 1,150 mg/100g (1.15% w/w, AOAC 940.03 Spectrophotometric Protocol).
- **Allophycocyanin (APC)**: 3.8% – 4.5% Active Phycobiliprotein (Boussiba & Richmond Protocol).
- **Scientific Demarcation**: Proximate chemical assays (IS 7219) quantify total macronutrients via acid digestion; bioactive chromoproteins and enzymes are heat-sensitive botanical biomarkers quantified via spectrophotometric protocols.

## Objective Competitor Benchmarking Summary
- **Parry Nutraceuticals**: Global industrial pioneer. Standard line uses industrial spray-drying yielding ~11–13% phycocyanin with 100% organic direct compression. Separate specialty line yields >20% phycocyanin.
- **Organic India**: Two distinct SKUs. Tablets (120 count, ₹510) contain 498.5mg Spirulina + ~0.3% INS 551 Silicon Dioxide glidant; Capsules (60 count, ₹450) contain pure biomass in vegetarian HPMC cellulose shells.
- **Carbamide Forte**: Discloses conventional excipients (PVPK30 binder, magnesium stearate, talc, MCC).
- **Patanjali Nutrela**: Multi-herb blend (56% spirulina + moringa, amla, ashwagandha), not pure single-herb biomass.
